_about: Public-domain Henry Suso (c.1295-1366, Dominican mystic of Constance and Ulm) in English for the Word Hoard: The Life of Blessed Henry Suso by Himself, tr. Thomas Francis Knox (1865) from CCEL, and the Little Book of Eternal Wisdom, tr. Richard Raby, second edition (1866) from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

suso-life-by-himself: The Life of Blessed Henry Suso by Himself, tr. Thomas Francis Knox (London: Burns, Lambert, and Oates, 1865)

suso-little-book-raby: Blessed Henry Suso's Little Book of Eternal Wisdom, tr. Richard Raby, second edition (London: Thomas Richardson, MDCCCLXVI)

_alternates.suso-little-book-1910: The Little Book of Eternal Wisdom with Hilton's Parable of the Pilgrim (Burns Oates; imprimatur 1910; CCEL suso/wisdom): translator not named
_alternates.suso-copies: Knox's Life, 1865 scan (lifeofblessedhen00seus) and Methuen's 1913 edition with Inge's introduction

_excluded.suso-others: Bevan's anthologies and The Three Friends of God (about him)
_excluded.suso-late: Clark's 1953 translation catalogued 1817, and editions of 1952-1962

_pending.suso-1575: Certayne sweete prayers (1575): title page unread
